scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'tutorera-backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'tutorera-frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix tutorera-backend run build && npm --prefix tutorera-frontend run build
